title: The three-dot menu is hidden on the non-editable system roles (Office User, Time Clock User)
custom_preconds: 1. You are on the Roles & Permissions list.
custom_steps:
1. Find the Office User row and the Time Clock User row.
  2. Look at the Actions column for each.
custom_expected: Only the eye icon is shown for Office User and Time Clock User — no pencil and no three-dot menu.
evidence: Office User & Time Clock User editable=false (live API).
